used_propositions: Registry entry 11847201 names HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED, registered in England and Wales, with status active.
Registry entry 11847299 names HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD, registered in England and Wales, with status active.
Helion Robotics Ltd (CRM operating name) and Helion Robotics Limited (invoices and Companies House) are described as the same legal entity.
Helion Industrial Systems Ltd is described as a different company from the Helion Robotics entity discussed in the same passage.
support_claim: Registry entries 11847201 and 11847299 ground to HELION ROBOTICS LIMITED and HELION INDUSTRIAL SYSTEMS LTD respectively, and commercial notes explicitly describe Helion Industrial Systems Ltd as a different company from the Helion Robotics legal entity.
